integrity: The exact facet-orbit data and group generators are embedded in verify.py; all stated finite counts and binary ranks were replayed from that packaged file.
limitations: Exact for the published A5-symmetric Brehm--Kühnel complex and mod-two middle homology. It does not classify all 15-vertex HP2 triangulations. The 1992 journal source is earlier but only year-resolved in the inspected public metadata, so the date field uses the earliest verified day-resolved public source and does not invent a day.
title: Triple-incidence spectrum of shortest middle-dimensional cycles in the 15-vertex projective-plane-like 8-manifold
